key_insight: eigenkit separates quantum algorithm definitions from execution backends, enabling portability when no single simulator or quantum processor is consistently best.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can compare execution providers without rewriting algorithms and integrate quantum workflows with NumPy, PyTorch, and scikit-learn.
method: Use a common circuit representation and provider interface.
Support 12 execution providers spanning simulators and quantum hardware.
evidence_signal: Simulator evaluations found workload-dependent performance, while IBM Heron and IQM Emerald experiments showed that algorithm-to-hardware connectivity alignment affects execution quality.
watch_item: A common interface does not eliminate backend capability differences, so provider selection still requires workload-specific validation.
paper_title: eigenkit: A Provider-Neutral Quantum Computing Library
